name: cache-weather-and-pause-resume
description: A band above the Claude Code prompt: prompt-cache countdown, cache hit rate, context weather with the auto-compact threshold, a Compact button and a Pause / Resume button that has Claude finish running work, save its state and wait. German and English.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows the locale (on Windows the system language); de or en pin it.

askAboveMinutes.title: Pause: ask above (minutes)
askAboveMinutes.description: When a task is likely to run longer than this many minutes at a pause, Claude asks whether to stop it now and restart it after resuming, or to let it finish.
